exposure: estimated fetal weight using Hadlock IV formula
cohort: 976 live-birth singleton pregnancies at the Shanghai General Hospital
finding: The Hadlock IV formula for estimating fetal weight in Chinese newborns had an overall accuracy rate of 79.61%, but its performance remained suboptimal, particularly in cases of suspected large-for-gestational age (LGA) infants, small-for-gestational age (SGA) infants, infants with macrosomia, or low birth weight fetuses.
mod_finding: The incidence of spontaneous vaginal delivery was lower in the group where estimated fetal weight was inaccurate compared to the group with accurate estimations.
